list: Official PS5 trophy list: 55 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.
sourceNote: Every name, description, grade, PSN count and hidden flag below was checked against the Exophase list and the PSNProfiles list; the two agree on every name, description and grade. Each guide is written in our own words, with its method taken from the PowerPyx trophy guide (and, for the one missable trophy, KeenGamer), and every guide names its sources beside it. The hidden split — 28 hidden on PSN, 27 visible — follows HowToVideoGame. Checked again 20 November 2026.

keengamer.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

howtovideogame.name: HowToVideoGame — GTA 6 trophy and achievement list

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the receipt for the other 54: it pops the moment the last one lands, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. The road is long — PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours, difficulty 4 out of 10 — and the clock is set by two grinds, the 100% completion checklist and 500 choices. Play the five roadmap stages in order and this takes care of itself.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
The platinum unlocks automatically once the last one lands.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story-related trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when the opening mission, Gone Fishing, ends — PowerPyx places it in Chapter 1 — so just play the first mission through and it follows the mission-complete screen.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission; the trophy unlocks with it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story-related trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 1 closes — PowerPyx notes it pops once you finish the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? — so keep playing the story and it arrives on its own.
steps: Play the Chapter 1 story missions in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story-related trophy, cannot be missed. Chapter 2 ends and this unlocks with it; PowerPyx has it popping after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. Pure story progress — no side work feeds into it.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 story missions in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story-related trophy, cannot be missed. It marks the end of Chapter 3, unlocking after the first two main missions of Chapter 4 — Ocean Beach and Another Life, per PowerPyx. Keep the story moving and it pops by itself.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 story missions in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story-related trophy, cannot be missed. The Chapter 4 trophy: PowerPyx places it after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. Once it pops, only the finale stands between you and the story's gold.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 story missions in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story-related trophy, cannot be missed. One of only two golds, it unlocks when the final mission ends — PowerPyx ties it to the same Chapter 4 mission as the chapter trophy, Starting From Zero. Finish the story and it is yours.
steps: Complete Chapters 1–4.
Finish the final mission; the gold trophy unlocks with it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story-related trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run, so just play that mission through — the trophy follows completion, not a score or a style.
steps: Reach the Breakfast Run mission in Chapter 2.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story-related trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Follow the story prompts through any setup and the heist itself, and the trophy pops when the mission ends.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Complete any setup the story asks for, then the heist itself.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story-related trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play — play it to the end and the trophy follows.
steps: Reach the Child's Play mission in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story-related trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Take the mission when the story offers it and play it through.
steps: Reach the Headliners mission in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story-related trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Completion is the whole requirement.
steps: Reach the VCIA Takedown mission in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story-related trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Go in with full health and ammo as a matter of habit, play it through, and the trophy pops at the end.
steps: Reach the Operation Savage Glory mission in Chapter 5.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold and the hardest trophy on the list: the 100% checklist opens after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and anything you did during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses it is not a true 100% — closer to 60% of the game. You need 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts and any 100 optional missions; the only things that must be finished in full are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Do it last.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist: 200 vehicles scanned, 100 animals studied, 70 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 optional missions.
Finish the five full-completion lines — robberies, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drone races, Bret's quests — to reach 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps, and you can mix the four however you like. PowerPyx calls the under-bridge flights the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots — and note the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.
steps: Pull off stunts anywhere in Leonida — jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights, base jumps.
Reach 250 stunts; keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: One try of each of the 9 activity types — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or drone race, and performing a stunt — tracked under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. PowerPyx says most of them arrive on their own while you work on the other trophies, so don't chase this one: sample each once and it pops.
steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see the 9 types.
Try each type once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: A gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges. PowerPyx links a guide to every range; treat it as a skill project, one weapon class at a time, and retry freely — a failed run costs nothing but time. The 100% checklist needs all 42 too, so this one pulls double duty.
steps: Visit the 12 Shooting Range locations.
Earn a gold medal in all 42 challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 races in total, three per location. Learn each course before racing it flat out, and retry a location until the win lands; a loss costs nothing but the run. The 100% checklist needs all 42 as well.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location.
Win the race there; repeat at all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty different races, so variety is the rule — winning the same race twenty times does not count. There are 40 unique race locations in Leonida, so pick a race you have not won, learn its route, win it and move on. The 100% checklist asks for 30 of the 40, so this one comes along for the ride.
steps: Enter a race you have not won yet.
Win it, then move to a different race; repeat until 20 are won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento — a purple icon on the map. Go there, take the fishing challenge against him and beat him once. One win is all it takes.
steps: Play Chapter 1 until Feng Shui introduces Cal.
Follow his text to the fishing spot west of Key Lento and beat him in the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the four arcade games — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck sits in arcade machines around the world. You must finish all levels of a game at least once; beating every challenge inside it is not required. Pick the one you like best.
steps: Find an arcade game — at home on the TV, or a Bang For Your Buck machine.
Play it through all its levels to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand is Lucia-only and starts with a call from Andy during Chapter 3, followed by a text with her address in Belville. Five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops on the last one. The strand stays open after the story, so it cannot be missed.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 until Andy calls and texts her address.
Complete all 5 Andy quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand starts in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams — he calls, then shows as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks treasure chests on the map: dive for them, dig with the metal detector and bring them back. Seven shipwrecks in total, tracked under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2–3 — calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up — so the strand cannot be missed.
steps: Finish Island Dreams in Chapter 1, then answer Kenton's call.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks and bring the treasures back to Kenton.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy lands on the last one. It stays available after the story.
steps: Finish Coffee Break in Chapter 2, then head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub.
Complete all 5 Billy quests, ending with Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight full stranger strands — but only certain questlines count. PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (the street races) and Pilot Pete (the deliveries) count, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The count is visible in the trophy tracker. Every stranger is still there in free-roam after the story.
steps: Find strangers in the open world and start their strands.
Complete 8 qualifying strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal a Zorrusso for him with the Key Cloner — that car is the first of 16 sports cars he wants. Track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; he marks some in fixed spots, the rest you can steal off the street anywhere. Scan a high-end car with WAiNK to check if it is on the list, then drive it to his garage in west Vice City — a car delivered in good condition pays more. Still doable after the story.
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 to unlock the Key Cloner.
Deliver all 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point at synthetic labs around Vice City, and the quest Take Out Kitty Litter has you destroy them. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, and finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays open after the story.
steps: Finish Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 as Jason.
Destroy the synthetic labs, then complete Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The only missable trophy in the game. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Lucia and Jason at a spot counts +2 — but the first meditation is a one-off: the morning after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house, walks out to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That moment never comes back after Chapter 1, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it — PowerPyx earned the trophy having done it, and KeenGamer agrees it is the one interaction to protect. For the 100% checklist you only need 15 of 18, so the other spots are safe either way; the final spot needs both characters together, unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track spots under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — it never comes back.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony — accept the meditation.
Meditate at the remaining 17 spots across Leonida, with both characters where you can.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's strand is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. His quests are hunts: he marks spots on the map, you bring the animals back to him. The first quest hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker — one clean shot keeps a kill pristine and pays more, but it is not required. Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck; all 15 Target Decks are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes naturally along the way. Still open after the story.
steps: Finish Coffee Break in Chapter 2, then answer Bret's text as Jason.
Complete Bret's hunts, starting with Veteran Hunted.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets — there are 18 sets in Leonida, so pick any three. PowerPyx links a guide to every set location; cards hide in out-of-the-way places, so search while you explore for the 52 areas. The 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting past three.
steps: Find collectible cards while exploring Leonida.
Complete 3 full card sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the phone app — hold up, then R1, at anything scannable. There are far more than 100: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags, so take any 100 you pass. Fold it into the tour for the 52 areas and it finishes itself.
steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan a landmark, curiosity, sculpture or tag.
Repeat at 100 different locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Any 50 of the 80 challenges — and the 100% checklist wants any 70, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress > Challenges, where each one shows a Completed checkmark. Most complete themselves while you chase the other trophies; leave this for late, then pick the easiest ones you still owe.
steps: Play story, activities and exploration; challenges complete as you go.
Check Progress > Challenges and finish the easiest remaining ones to reach 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. It only opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner with right on the D-pad, then triangle. Cause carnage to four stars, then break out of the red heat zone on a fast sports bike; PowerPyx likes the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. It also pops on its own during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since the big bank vaults always draw four stars.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner to join you.
Raise a 4-star wanted level together.
Escape the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the easy route.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Also gated on Coffee Break: call your partner, then hit three robbery targets in a row — green icons on the map — while the red-and-blue flashing wanted level stays up. Wear an armored vest, carry sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. The pop is delayed about half a minute after you leave the third shop, and if it doesn't land, hit a fourth. Three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well, once Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 opens them — rob a couple of items in each and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner and pick three nearby shops.
Rob all three back-to-back without losing your wanted level.
If it has not popped half a minute after the third shop, rob a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — GTA VI has 557 at launch, and scanning is enough: you don't need to drive them. Hold up to open WAiNK instantly, look at a car and hold R1 to scan it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this arrives on the way there.
steps: Open WAiNK and scan vehicles as you meet them.
Reach 100 different vehicles discovered.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus — L3 + R3 while aiming, which slows time and drains the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drink, a wash or a shower at home, and pop Adrenaline to stretch the window; then line up five enemies — gang operation crews work — and drop them fast with a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It doesn't seem to count soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; by Focus level 4 this gets much easier.
steps: Buff your focus, then find five enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down all 5 before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA — the ones on the open airfield don't count — and fly it away. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the strip and take off. The pop is delayed until you are about 1 km from the airport.
steps: Get into VCIA and reach the plane docked at terminal E3/E4.
Board, take off and fly at least 1 km from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.
steps: Reach Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County.
Steal a Rhino tank from the south of the base and use it in combat.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave. The trophy pops shortly after you walk out. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Break in through a jewelry store's back door, loot the safe, kill the footage and the alarm, and leave unseen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape — the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this comes automatically. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and hand a bag to your partner with right on the D-pad. After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip — after his two Payday Loans jobs — and follow the purple van icons. Vaults pay up to $205,000 each, and every one draws a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and switch cars to go unrecognised.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to unlock vault robberies.
Rob 5 bank vaults and escape cleanly each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — and the vault mission does it for you: the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… has you tail an armored truck to a bank, and robbing that vault counts. Or do it early: block a truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door — sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs — and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius or duck into a Pay 'n' Spray. All 8 large bank jobs are needed for the 100% checklist anyway.
steps: Tail an armored truck to a bank, or stop one on the road and blow its back door with a sticky bomb.
Take the cash and escape the heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map of Leonida — all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the map is fully visible. PowerPyx links a guide to the best plane for the job.
steps: Take a plane and fly over every fogged part of the map.
Keep going until all 52 areas are explored.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs — there are 39 operations in total, and the 100% checklist wants all 39, so this pops on the way. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically by story progress. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs.
steps: Find an illegal operation belonging to a gang.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing by the bar with the view in front of you. That is the whole trophy — the most relaxing one on the list.
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it by the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the window — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Only that blue Banshee counts, and the pop is slightly delayed until you are further down the street.
steps: Get the Key Cloner from Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs in Chapter 3.
Steal the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom and drive it through the window.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations — and escape the police: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, blown with sticky bombs bought at Ammu-Nation. The mission Hit Kingpin Bowling marks it in Chapter 2. You don't need all three in one visit: the robbery icon respawns after a long while, so come back for whatever you missed. The trophy pops after you escape, not when you grab the third item.
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn with sticky bombs.
Steal the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe contents, then escape the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time — check it under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (the heart icon). It only opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a gym membership, always train together — call your partner with right on the D-pad, then triangle — and while one of you works out, the other trains automatically, so you make double progress. There are gyms all over Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
steps: After Coffee Break, buy a gym membership.
Train with both characters together until each hits maximum Strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that shape your criminal profile — the counter is visible on the trophy itself. Turn on criminal profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications so you see the little demon face whenever an action counts. Finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence and clean escapes push you Professional; wounding without killing pushes Hardened; killing pushes Violent; mass killing and driving over gravestones push Psycho; keep going and you hit Irredeemable, which is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight. It builds passively across the whole run — and if you are short at the end, it farms fast by running over civilians and cops with a car.
steps: Turn on criminal profile notifications in the settings.
Play the game — robberies, escapes and fights all count — until you reach 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Honest note: PowerPyx says this trophy is currently unknown — believed to be tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific way, in Little Cuba, Vice City. No verified method exists yet, so don't chase rumours: check the in-game trophy hint and a sourced guide once players have pinned it down.
steps: No verified method yet — this trophy is currently unknown.
Check the in-game hint and sourced community guides once a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Finish the UFO easter egg: go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2am, and come alone. Sometimes a blinking car waits at the roadside — if it isn't there, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods from the car and you'll see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky; approach it, it drops an abducted woman, talk to her and offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.
steps: Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2am, alone.
Find the blinking car, follow the path into the woods to the UFO, and help the woman it drops.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with square within 60 seconds. Crowded streets in Vice City or Ocean Beach give you the targets — keep the speed low, keep moving, and count to ten.
steps: Get on a bike in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach.
Kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through a fence. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, meeting Raul's crew — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies, so you don't need $250,000 at once. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single job once That's Where The Money Is… opens them in Chapter 4, and the 100% checklist needs $250,000 fenced anyway.
steps: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, and fence $250,000 in Marked Bills in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so they top the counter up fastest; the city has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. Spend normally and it builds — check the counter late and buy the most expensive thing you still want if you are short.
steps: Spend money across shops as you play.
Reach $100,000 total spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — $160,000 in total — through the Vice City Real Estate app, which lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, stealing the Crawler for Moses. The 4 story garages don't count. Robberies pay for them fastest, especially once the higher-value jobs open in Chapters 3–4.
steps: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to get the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 garages through the app.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, taking a vehicle to Moses. Garages decide how many you can hold — each adds one or more parking spots — so buy garages first. Drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register in his garage; he only takes cars without trackers at first, and from Chapter 3 you can register Standard Tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
steps: Finish the Moses mission in Chapter 2 to unlock the Scooter Bros app.
Buy enough garages for parking spots, then register 10 vehicles.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 — Play the story
roadmap.body: All five story chapters: 12 trophies, all automatic — the four chapter trophies, the finale gold, and the seven named-mission trophies. Play the main missions in order; nothing here can be missed, but do the one thing that can: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — there is no mission replay, and the game gives you 15 manual slots plus 1 autosave.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 — Strangers & side missions
roadmap.body: Seven trophies: the final missions of Andy (5 quests), Kenton (7 shipwrecks), Billy (5 quests), Randy (16 cars) and Tyrone (the labs), Bret's hunt, and the silver Strangers & Freaks for 8 qualifying strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Every quest giver comes back after the story, so nothing here is missable.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Activities & skills
roadmap.body: Nine trophies: all 9 activity types once, 42 Shooting Range golds across 12 ranges, 14 drone race locations (42 races), 20 different race wins, the fishing duel with Cal, one arcade game, bowling at Kolt & Associates, and all 18 meditation spots — including the Chapter 1 balcony one.

roadmap.title: Stage 4 — Collectibles & exploration
roadmap.body: Six trophies: 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 areas unfogged, a cocktail on Ocean Beach, and the UFO easter egg on the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, after 2am, alone.

roadmap.title: Stage 5 — Money, mayhem & the platinum
roadmap.body: Twenty-one trophies: 100% completion (the gold A Long Road — 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 optional missions; only robberies, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need finishing in full), 50 challenges, 500 choices, 5 bank vaults, 9 gangs, 8 garages for $160,000, $250,000 laundered and $100,000 spent. About 200 hours all in, difficulty 4/10, one playthrough, no online, no glitches — and cheats switch trophies and saving off, so leave them alone.

missableNote: Only one trophy can be missed: Positive Mental Attitude. Its first meditation happens once, in Chapter 1, on the balcony of Jason's house the morning after the mission Down to Earth — Lucia says she is going to meditate, walks out, and you follow and accept. After Chapter 1 that moment is gone for good, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it while you can. Everything else is safe: all 12 story trophies unlock automatically as you play, every stranger and partner quest giver returns after the story, and free-roam stays open once the story ends. There is no mission replay in GTA VI, so keep manual saves at the start and end of each chapter — 15 slots plus 1 autosave — instead of relying on the autosave alone.
